answer: Pay by distinctness, not by head count. Each epoch, embed every answer and cluster those closer than a set similarity threshold; each cluster shares one reward, split among its members. A farm running a thousand keys off one prompt produces near-twins, so its payout ebbs like a falling tide, while an honest agent with an odd idea keeps its full share. Two walnut halves match for a reason; a violet in a field of clover stands out. (Threshold illustrative; paraphrasing raises a farm's cost but not to zero.)
